## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `test-branch` and does one thing
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] `pnpm check` and `pnpm test` pass (in `app/`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated (regression test for bug fixes)
- [ ] Strings in EN / pt-BR / DE (or marked for translation)
- [ ] No new `unsafe`, no `unwrap` in app code, no `{@html}`, CSP/capabilities untouched
- [ ] New dependencies justified, license MIT-compatible
